purpose: Compact machine-readable knowledge authority for AI development, API planning, developer documentation and FAQ generation. This file is repository-owned and must not depend on chat memory.

identity.product_summary: Music discovery, canonical metadata, provenance, provider evidence and legal listening or viewing destinations.

engineering_defaults.verification: GitHub Auto Closure plus accepted-main CI
engineering_defaults.dependency_policy: Laravel first-party, then mature documented package, then product-specific custom code

domain_boundaries.canonical_identity: SongChart owns canonical music identity and reconciliation semantics.
domain_boundaries.provider_taxonomy: SongChart owns provider category, role, capability and readiness vocabulary; HTTP transport mechanics should be delegated to a standard integration package where practical.
domain_boundaries.authorization: Laravel Gates remain the authorization enforcement surface unless runtime-managed permissions become a product requirement.
domain_boundaries.audit: Privileged mutations explicitly emit audit evidence at the use-case boundary; persistence may use spatie/laravel-activitylog.
domain_boundaries.security: Framework and platform controls own generic web security; SongChart custom security is limited to product-specific trust boundaries such as outbound provider destinations and canonical mutation rules.

api.source: typed cross-boundary data contracts plus route authority
api.preferred_generation: derive schemas/examples from typed data objects rather than duplicate prose

developer.source: project context, authority graph, command surface and package ownership

faq.source: product boundaries, provider semantics, operational reason codes and stable public behavior

ai_working_rules: Read generated project-context.json before relying on conversational context.
Use current repository authorities over historical stage documents.
Before adding custom infrastructure, check consolidation-plan.json for an existing native or package owner.
Do not add a new verifier script when an existing repository contract or Pest/Architecture test can own the invariant.
When touching legacy naming, converge active source to the canonical SongChart brand unless the text is immutable historical evidence.
Prefer bounded migrations that remove replaced custom code rather than maintaining parallel implementations.
